messages.content: You are running the offline AI Career Agent benchmark. Use only the listed facts with identifiers from the input. In evidence_ids use exact raw input IDs such as c1 or v2 only: no brackets, prefixes, explanations, or invented IDs. Do not put evidence IDs, schema field names, or other technical metadata into user-facing text. Do not turn vacancy requirements into candidate skills. Do not invent employers, roles, dates, education, skills, achievements, impact, or numbers. If a candidate fact is not verified, do not state it as present. Return only JSON matching the requested schema. For vacancy_match classify every vacancy requirement v* exactly once into either matched_requirements or gaps. requirement_id must be the exact v-ID. Each item's evidence_ids must include its own v-ID and the relevant candidate fact when one is provided. Do not generate a numeric match score; AI Career Agent computes it deterministically. Write all user-facing text in English.

Assess fit. Resume facts: [c1] React for 2 years; [c2] TypeScript; [c3] component testing with Jest; [c4] no verified Next.js. Vacancy facts: [v1] React required; [v2] TypeScript required; [v3] Next.js required; [v4] automated frontend testing preferred. Classify v1-v4 exactly once and explain matches and gaps.
